method: Two deterministic policies: immediate-only versus mixed. Mixed uses at most3 actual revealBreath calls per battle, once per player turn, then sees only getBreath category. No getIntent or enemy.intentIndex reads for decisions. Immediate mode uses documented printed-value estimates plus visible first-hit buffs; no preview or future-action oracle is read. Estimates only rank choices; authoritative combat runs in the engine. Full runs use public game actions from56HP/60spirit stones/exact starter, normal items/rewards/equipment/rest; no HP/card/resource injections or forced kills. Isolated benchmarks only arrange first node enemy identity/kind, use natural56HP/exact starter and no consumables. Full-route same seeds diverge naturally as different combat lengths consume RNG; not matched later encounter sequences. This is a heuristic mechanics comparison, not human playtest or difficulty acceptance.
